messages:
monitor-bot: ALERT: Dropped GPU pool health in eu-south2. 85% of nodes reporting 'provisioning_timeout' over the last 2m.
ops_alyssa: seeing it, metrics show kube-scheduler backlog + KV cache errors.
oncall_raj: I’m on the bridge. first-pass: network flaps to colo provider causing instance provisioning to stall.
sre_marta: confirmed, BGP session resets from isp-eu-south observed at 09:12 UTC.
ops_alyssa: are Dedicated/Dedicated-reserved customers affected or just hosted?
eng-ml_jasper: Hosted and Dedicated burst pools in eu-south2 hit allocation failures; pinned reserved pools should be fine but autoscale cannot fill.
support_luis: support queue: 6 urgent tickets from EU customers reporting elevated latency and 2 embedded timeouts. Customers asking for ETA.
pm_helen: we need a clear customer message: statuspage + support template. ETA best-effort?
oncall_raj: immediate mitigation: shift new placement to eu-west1 and ap-north1 for latency-sensitive routes. Running traffic-shift policy now: `rbctl route set --region eu-south2 --fallback eu-west1,ap-north1 --weight 0.2`
sre_marta: doing a gradual shift (20% -> 50% -> 100%) to avoid cold-start spike. monitoring autoscaler metrics.
eng-ml_jasper: note: some model variants not available in ap-north1; fallback will pick quantized variants. Quality impact likely for ~5% of requests.
ops_alyssa: cost note: forced cross-region routing + burst capacity will increase egress and GPU spot usage. Finance FYI: estimate $8k/day if sustained.
support_luis: support template ready, will add per-customer impact based on whether they use pinned capacity. Draft: "We're experiencing provisioning failures in eu-south2; traffic is being shifted to neighboring regions. Some requests may experience higher latency or quantized model variants. We're investigating and will provide an ETA within 30 minutes."
pm_helen: edit: add sentence about dedicated/reserved unaffected for pinned pools and contact support for SLA concerns.
statuspage-bot: DRAFT STATUS: "Partial outage in eu-south2 affecting new allocations and some hosted requests. We are shifting traffic to eu-west1 and ap-north1. No data loss reported. Updates every 30 minutes."
oncall_raj: ops runbook steps in progress: 1) prevent new allocations in eu-south2 (`clusterctl cordon eu-south2-provisioners`) 2) scale up eu-west1 burst pool 3) watch KV cache pressure 4) enable model-fallback mapping.
sre_marta: cordon complete. eu-west1 burst scaled +15 nodes. KV pressure reduced by 12%.
eng-ml_jasper: doing a controlled FALLBACK mapping: `modelspec fallback --from eu-south2 --to eu-west1 --variants quantized_low` (audit logged).
ops_alyssa: ETA estimate: provisioning vendor indicates partial restoration in 40-60 minutes, full stability 2-3 hours. Marking customer-facing ETA: 1 hour for restoration of normal allocations.
support_luis: posting to customers now, will triage the 2 high-priority tickets with dedicated customers and escalate to CSMs.
pm_helen: prepare Exec summary for sales & enterprise: short bullet list and affected customer list.
statuspage-bot: UPDATE POSTED: "Initial mitigation underway; traffic shift active. Estimated time to restorative allocations: ~1 hour. Next update in 30 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops_alyssa: keeping the bridge open. If vendor SLA slips we start plan B: provision from alternate colo partner (longer spin up ~45m).
oncall_raj: +1. If we trigger alternate colo, notify finance for immediate approval (cost > $20k/day).
sre_marta: continuing to monitor offsets. I'll post perf graphs in 10m.
monitor-bot: NOTE: latency spike observed in fallback region for 2m after 100% shift, autoscaler added 7 nodes.
eng-ml_jasper: watching quality regressions on the evals; forcing canary rollback for model family "redwood-13b-std" if >3% regression.
ops_alyssa: thanks team. keep comms tight.
statuspage-bot: NEXT UPDATE SCHEDULED in 30 minutes."
